description: Full SolidCAM GPPL language support for VSCode: highlighting, formatting, autocomplete, code lens, code snippets and more. Write your postprocessor for SolidCAM like a pro.
configuration.title: GPPL
configuration.trace.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the GPPL language server.
configuration.encoding.description: Target ANSI encoding for GPPL files. Characters not representable in this encoding will be flagged.
configuration.encoding.windows1252: Western European (default for most SolidCAM installations)
configuration.workspace.maxFiles.descrip: Maximum number of .gpp files indexed by the workspace scanner (PRO multi-file). Files beyond this cap are skipped.
configuration.workspace.excludeGlobs.des: Glob patterns excluded from workspace file scanning (PRO multi-file). Replaces the default set.
configuration.proRequestEmail.descriptio: Email address used when the user requests a PRO license via mailto:. Ignored if proRequestUrl is set.
configuration.proRequestUrl.description: URL of a web form (Yandex/Google Forms, etc.) opened when the user requests a PRO license. If set, proRequestEmail is ignored.
configuration.proRequestToken.descriptio: Optional request token sent to the PRO license request backend. Must match the GPPL_REQUEST_TOKEN environment variable on the backend.
